# Llama Swap — DEX Meta-Aggregator Reference

> A DEX meta-aggregator that compares quotes across many DEX aggregators and DEXs to find the best output (most tokens received) for a swap, net of gas. Non-custodial — your wallet signs. Independent, not affiliated with DefiLlama.

## Key Facts
- Concept: DEX meta-aggregator — compares quotes across many aggregators and DEXs, picks the route with the best net output after gas
- Custody: non-custodial — Llama Swap builds the route/transaction; your wallet signs and no operator holds funds
- Chains: works across EVM chains; gas is paid in the chain's native coin
- Costs: pool and DEX fees on the chosen route + network gas + price impact; ERC-20 spend needs a one-time approval
- Surfaces price impact, slippage tolerance, pool/DEX fees and estimated gas before you sign
- Common pairs: ETH <-> USDC / USDT and major tokens with on-chain liquidity
- Independent resource — NOT affiliated with or endorsed by DefiLlama
